title: Late Season Corn: Tar Spot and Plant Health Check
reason: Provides an update on corn health and tar spot assessment.

tasks.task: Assess late season plant health and tar spot in corn fields.

subtasks.text: Observe a field of susceptible hybrid corn showing signs of extensive tar spot, covering the upper leaves.
Describe the conditions in southern Iowa where some fields experienced aggressive tar spot through August and September.

tasks.task: Provide recommendations for managing tar spot and its impact on crop quality.

subtasks.text: Note that susceptible hybrids can be severely affected by tar spot, but the impact may not be on yield.
Explain the importance of checking fields for tar spot and other plant health issues before harvest.
Highlight the need to manage tar spot holistically, including proper fungicide application timing.

tasks.task: Invite viewers to access additional information and support from Pioneer.

subtasks.text: Mention that viewers can get tar spot tolerance ratings and agronomy insights from Pioneer's website and social media channels.
